reviews.title: Keep authored-source mask limitations explicit in AS2 coverage
reviews.summary: Geometric masks and cached dynamic gradient/PNG/mixed masks work in exported AS2. Cached authored gradient masks lose their opacity ramp, and authored PNG sources are rejected; the rejected assignment can escape AS2 catch handling. Mask support remains useful but partial.

entries.note: Geometric and cached dynamic alpha masks work; cached authored gradients lose transparency and authored PNG masks reject, with the refusal escaping AS2 catch handling.
